description:
Which named action plans run around (and inside) the scan.

Each slot lists plan names from the experiment's action library.  Leave
a slot empty for "nothing".

setup.description: Plans to run once before the scan starts.
setup.title: Setup

per_step.description: Plans to run between scan steps — after each move, before the shots at that position.
per_step.title: Per Step

closeout.description: Plans to run once after the scan finishes (even on abort).
closeout.title: Closeout
